title: What Prison Education Networks 2.0 Is
definition: Prison Education Networks 2.0: next-gen education in prisons.

title: Prison Education Networks 2.0 Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Prison Education Networks 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Prison Education Networks 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 56067 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where secure tablets monitoring, network logistics redundancy, or curriculum maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Prison Education Networks 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Prison Education Networks 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Prison Education Networks 2.0 — next-gen education in prisons.

Phase 1 — Prove (secure tablets): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (network logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (curriculum): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (reentry links): network hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and justice-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
